title: A Letter to the Captain

readiness.reading: choosing and reading words to write a letter

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Sailing with Captain Mara, and racing at the lake! You've had a watery fortnight.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Would you like to write to the Captain, to thank her for the voyage?

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Write the letter: choose a word for each coloured space.
lines: I will come to the {place} again soon.
Thank you for taking me on the voyage.
Fair winds until I see you again {when}.

lake: steered a boat in the regatta

feedback.all_good: A sailor's letter! Captain Mara will pin it up in her cabin.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Off it goes down the coast road. I think she'll read it aloud to the whole crew.

journal_line: I wrote a thank-you letter to Captain Mara.
